fields.name: Reports
fields.evidence: Toolkit EoCClient.dll+0xBD9900 ecl::mod::PendingModReportsSystem::ProcessPendingAdditions(PendingReportsSingletonComponent*) looks uint64 mod ids up in the component (bucket count +8) and get-or-inserts FUN_180BD89A0(component, &id), copying a 0x28-byte record; ProcessPendingSends walks keys (+0x20, stride 8) and values (+0x30, stride 0x28). Value struct name ecl::mod::PendingModReportInfo is the game's (macOS SaveReportToDisk(ecl::mod::PendingModReportInfo&, ...)), its 0x28 size and layout match. macOS default: zeroed 64 bytes; live: empty.
